title: The Bandits' Toll
text: A rope hung with bells stretches across the road, with three bandits behind it. They are very polite and very well armed, their coats taken from better people. A toll, they say, for the road's upkeep. Nobody has kept up this road in a hundred years.

options.label: Pay their toll and smile, and save your blades for worthier foes.

outcomes.text: They lift the rope with a bow and a jingle of bells. Each coin is counted carefully as they watch you go.

options.label: The best talker talks them down, with silver words instead of silver coin.

outcomes.text: By the end they are paying you to leave, though none of them is sure why.
They are not persuaded. Their smiles stay fixed while their hands drift toward their blades.

options.label: Cut the rope and see what they do. No one tolls this road but you.

outcomes.text: The three bandits are not alone; their friends wait in the trees. This was always how it would end, whatever you paid.
